name: Jiiya no Taroyama - Taro no Mongol Yuubokumin Taiken Ryokouki
original_name: じぃやのタローヤマ　タローのモンゴル遊牧民体験旅行記
source:
Based on the diary of a college student who traveled to Mongolia during spring break, this is a photo essay with background music.
Immerse yourself in the vast grasslands through words and photos, and experience the beauty of nomadic life.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/521]freem[/url]]
